page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz and includes a 35 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of dedicated system memory, translating to 4.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance primarily in the lower tiers for compute and memory operations. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench register in the bottom 25% or bottom 10% categories. Memory bandwidth reads are also relatively weak, though large-block uncached write performance reaches average levels at 33.29 GB/sec. Cryptographic and compression tasks show poor to weak results, with single-threaded gzip compression at 18.99 GB/sec. However, the CPU's extended instructions test and small-model LLM inference processing, such as prompt processing at 446.56 tokens/sec, achieve average performance.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.sn2.xlarge offers a predictable hardware profile suitable for general-purpose workloads that do not demand high-performance computing. Because it lacks local storage and exhibits weak database and Redis performance, it is best suited as an application server, for lightweight web serving, or for running small-scale containerized applications where baseline network throughput and moderate memory capacity are sufficient.

It features 8 vCPUs, 32.0 GB of system memory, and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, with no local storage or GPU accelerators. Benchmark results indicate weak single-core and multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng and Geekbench scores falling in the bottom 25%.
